images.scene: An empty dirt road at dawn, camera very low at ground level. A single man in simple work clothes walks AWAY from the camera, small in the lower part of the frame, carrying a heavy sack over one shoulder, body leaning into the weight but stepping firmly, dissolving into the haze ahead. Nothing else in the frame. Soft low light, long shadow behind him.

Before dawn, the bare cement floor by the front door of a simple Brazilian house, camera at floor level. One pair of worn, dusty work boots stands laced and ready by the door, alone, the first grey light of morning coming through the doorway and touching them. Nothing else in the frame; the room dissolves into haze above.
